description: This file is a Perl script named 'slugimage.pl' used for manipulating NSLU2 firmware images. It contains functions for reading, writing, and modifying firmware partitions, including parsing partition tables, padding data, and constructing firmware images. The script supports both unpacking existing firmware images and creating new ones, with command-line options for specifying input/output files and configurations.

methods.name: padBytes
methods.description: Pads input data with 0xff bytes up to the specified total length.

methods.name: paddedSize
methods.description: Calculates the next multiple of block size greater than or equal to a given data length.

methods.name: numBlocks
methods.description: Returns the number of blocks needed to hold a given data length.

methods.name: createPartitionEntry
methods.description: Creates a binary partition entry from name, base address, size, and optional skips.

methods.name: parsePartitionEntry
methods.description: Parses a binary partition entry and returns its components.

methods.name: findPartitionTable
methods.description: Finds a partition table within a firmware data buffer.

methods.name: parsePartitionTable
methods.description: Parses a partition table and returns arrays of partition info.

methods.name: writeOut
methods.description: Writes data to a specified filename.

methods.name: trailerData
methods.description: Creates trailer data buffer, currently not used.

methods.name: printRedbootTrailer
methods.description: Prints information from a RedBoot trailer.

methods.name: removeOptionalLoader
methods.description: Removes the Loader partition and sets fixed offsets for Kernel and Ramdisk.

methods.name: spliceFirmwarePartitions
methods.description: Updates partition list based on the firmware's partition table.

methods.name: layoutPartitions
methods.description: Calculates and assigns start, size, and offset for each partition, adjusting for headers and skip regions.

methods.name: buildPartitionTable
methods.description: Generates the binary partition table data from the current partition list.

methods.name: writeOutFirmware
methods.description: Assembles the firmware image from partitions and writes to a file.

methods.name: readInFirmware
methods.description: Reads an existing firmware image file and populates partition data structures.

methods.name: readInFirmwareParts
methods.description: Reads data from partition files into memory, with optional byte-swapping.
